pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, light-brown polygonal patches with relatively smooth, non-crenellated edge gradients. The regions exhibit moderate spatial area with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, high-contrast cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological network. Junction nodes are clearly defined at the intersection of three to four pathways with consistent pixel thickness across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, upright mane along the dorsal neck ridge with a consistent, low-amplitude serrated profile against the light background.
